info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Payments Payments Refunds-v4-spec
info.description: The Payment Refunds Management API allows businesses to access and list refunds related to payment transactions. This endpoint provides the ability to retrieve detailed information about payments that have been refunded, aiding in financial management and customer service follow-ups. It is designed for use by financial teams, customer support representatives, and developers integrating payment solutions. This functionality supports enhanced visibility into refund activities and helps ensure accurate transaction records.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the details of a specific payment refund, including the status and reason for the refund. It is intended for users who need to verify or audit refund transactions.

requestBody.description: This operation is used to initiate a refund request for a payment. The request body must contain the necessary details to process the refund.

202.description: Request accepted and is being processed.

ListPaymentsPaymentsRefundsRequest.description: This schema represents a request body for a GET operation related to payment refunds.

status.description: Indicates whether the refund operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number assigned to the refund request.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the refund operation.

state.description: The current state of the refund operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the refund operation, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the refund operation.

ListPaymentsPaymentsRefundsResponse_202.description: Response schema for refund operation in payments API indicating the status and details of the refund process.

createdBy.description: The user who created the refund request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the refund request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the refund operation was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information about the refund operation, including who created it and when.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken by the server to process the refund request, measured in milliseconds.
